summary: WP-P2 coding-delivery audit correction after commit b13a2e8df431ccb7f16e10a9d4a8c142c19ff7cd. The production retrieval module and deterministic completion are accepted and frozen for this repair; CodingAndReparing is authorized only to remove content-, control-word-, lifecycle-, and anchor-based routing from the uninjected default MCP semantic path in systemarchitecture-mcp-server.js. Every ordinary semantic query must enter approved external credential resolution, persistent readiness, qualified embedding, and persistent vector retrieval. Only omitted-query and graph-tidy calls retain full-snapshot behavior.
